items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I left there and went to Central Avenue and started to work for Curtis Moseby at the Apex Club... Curtis Moseby was a bandleader. Curtis Moseby and his Blues Blowers.

ctx.x: Well, this was still just, what, a year after you'd gotten out of high school, right?

Yeah. So then I left there and went to Central Avenue and started to work for Curtis Moseby at the Apex Club? (WILLARD: The Apex Club?) (SIMMONS: no, what was the name of the club? Nemo.) (WILLARD: The Nemo Lounge.) Yeah. Well, now, Curtis Moseby was a bandleader. Curtis Moseby and his Blues Blowers.
